_notes: source: canon = on-screen; beta = licensed books/games; original = invented for this game. tier: flow | strategic | exotic | refined | faction | trade_good. Trade goods are sold for latinum rather than spent.

resources.name: Tritanium
resources.lore: Principal hull material of TOS-era starships; far harder than titanium.

resources.name: Duranium
resources.lore: Common Federation hull and shuttle alloy.

resources.name: Deuterium
resources.lore: Heavy hydrogen; matter half of the warp reaction and impulse fuel.

resources.name: Dilithium
resources.lore: Regulates matter/antimatter reaction. Scarce in TOS; recrystallization later; nearly gone after the Burn.

resources.name: Latinum
resources.lore: Liquid at room temperature, cannot be replicated; suspended in gold (slips, strips, bars, bricks).

resources.name: Crew
resources.lore: Inspired by Star Trek: Armada's crew resource.

resources.name: Verterium Cortenide
resources.lore: Usually synthetic; the only known substance that generates a warp field when energized.

resources.name: Kelbonite
resources.lore: Refractory metal that blocks scans and transporter beams (TNG 'Silicon Avatar').

resources.name: Pergium
resources.lore: Mined at Janus VI ('The Devil in the Dark') — site of the Horta conflict.

resources.name: Topaline
resources.lore: Capella IV mining rights ('Friday's Child'). Here: required for colonies on airless bodies.

resources.name: Zenite
resources.lore: Ardana ('The Cloud Minders'); raw zenite gas impairs the miners.

resources.name: Rodinium
resources.lore: Cast rodinium armored the Neutral Zone outposts; hardest known material in 2266 ('Balance of Terror').

resources.name: Uridium
resources.lore: Processed on Terok Nor during the Cardassian occupation.

resources.name: Cormaline
resources.lore: Bajoran mineral, a target of Cardassian strip-mining.

resources.name: Trellium-D
resources.lore: ENT Expanse era: hull lining protects against spatial anomalies; neurotoxic to Vulcans.

resources.name: Boronite
resources.lore: Ore used in synthesizing the Omega molecule (VOY 'The Omega Directive').

resources.name: Benamite
resources.lore: Crystals required for quantum slipstream drive (VOY).

resources.name: Sirillium
resources.lore: Volatile gas/fuel mentioned in TOS-era ships; here harvested from nebulae.

resources.name: Metreon Gas
resources.lore: Extremely volatile; ignited by weapons fire. Basis of the Haakonian metreon cascade.

resources.name: Protomatter
resources.lore: Unstable; its use in the Genesis Device caused the Genesis Planet to collapse.

resources.name: Neutronium
resources.lore: The Doomsday Machine's hull; shrugged off phasers.

resources.name: Trilithium
resources.lore: Nuclear inhibitor; Soran's star-destroying probes (Generations). Resin is a warp-core byproduct.

resources.name: Omega Molecule
resources.lore: Unlimited power; instability destroys subspace, making warp impossible across a region.

resources.name: Red Matter
resources.lore: Creates black holes (Star Trek 2009).

resources.name: Parasteel
resources.lore: Original alloy for this game (name not from Trek canon).

resources.name: Transparent Aluminum
resources.lore: Formula 'given' to 20th-century Earth in The Voyage Home.

resources.name: Photon Warheads
resources.lore: Antimatter warhead casings; sirillium boosts the yield.

resources.name: Honor
resources.lore: Earned in battle, lost by dishonorable acts; spent at the Great Hall.

resources.name: Self-Sealing Stem Bolts
resources.lore: Nobody knows what they're for. Ferengi will sell them anyway.
